root_idea.summary: The root conveys heaviness, force, and substantial mass, with things or parts bearing upon one another. Its lexical branches include a mountain mass or spur, burdensome censure, impaired judgment, and falsehood.
root_idea.development: The physical image of a mountain portion or peak develops into senses of weight or severity in reproach, mental impairment associated especially with extreme age, and falsehood—possibly because the liar is blamed or bears a heavy sin. These root-level relations are not automatically meanings of every derivative.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested Form II verb is presented under its normalized perfect-tense dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: To attribute weakness or unsoundness of judgment to someone; to deem someone mentally impaired.
senses.usage_conditions: In لَوْلَا أَنْ تُفَنِّدُونِ (Quran 12:94), the construction describes treating the speaker as weak-minded. The verse is also interpreted contextually as “blame or reproach me,” but that is treated here as an interpretation of the same construction rather than a separate basic sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie, utter a falsehood, or say what is untrue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Identified as the primary signification of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To err or make repeated mistakes in speech, judgment, or opinion; to become weak or unsound in mind, or to become extremely aged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is especially associated with extreme old age, though it is also reported without that restriction and may be associated with disease. The aging sense is linked to confused or perverted speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become impotent and unthankful for divine favor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An additionally reported usage, marked as tentative in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pronounce someone a liar, accuse him of falsehood, or declare his speech untrue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II usage distinct from attributing weakness of judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pronounce a person or his judgment weak, impotent, or lacking in ability.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The judgment-related portion overlaps the Quran-attested weakness-of-judgment construction; the declaration of impotence or lack of ability is retained here as a broader Classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquire or secure a horse, especially for frontier watch, protection, or refuge; also, according to one usage, to make a horse lean for military service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized horse-related construction, with differing lexical explanations reported for its precise application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire that someone perform an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction فَنَّدَ فُلَانًا عَلَى الأَمْرِ or فِي الأَمْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persist constantly or perseveringly in drinking beverage or wine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with فِي الشَّرَابِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit upon a mountain spur or peak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a فِنْد, meaning a projecting part or peak of a mountain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To charge someone with error in judgment or opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render someone weak in judgment, unsound in mind, or deficient in understanding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially attributed to extreme old age, which may leave a person with little understanding, figuratively like a stone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repent of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْهُ to indicate the thing repented of.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be caused to perish through extreme old age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive Form VIII usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great mountain, an isolated mountain, or a substantial portion, peak, spur, or side of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer broadly to a mountain mass or more specifically to a projecting or elevated part of one; its plural is أَفْنَادٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A portion or component of the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the plural expression أَفْنَادُ اللَّيْلِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A party or company of people; in the plural, separate or scattered companies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural أَفْنَادٌ is used for groups proceeding one after another or separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Those characterized by impotence and ingratitude for divine favor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported alternative interpretation of a transmitted expression, distinct from the sense “companies” or “parties.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sort or species; a distinct kind or variety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plural may describe people or things arriving as diverse sorts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A branch of a tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal botanical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land upon which rain has not fallen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An associated adjectival form is also reported, but the directly attested lexical item here is فِنْدٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Exorbitance or impropriety in speech, and error in judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive use of the verbal noun, distinct as a noun from the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A complete branch from which a bow is made.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for a suitably formed branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sharp adze.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The spelling without hamza is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bold or fearless she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate lexical usage from the tool sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An adze, axe, or hoe, especially one with a broad head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plural فَنَادِيدُ is reported as anomalous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A type of sweetmeat made from concentrated sugar-cane juice and starch.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The item is identified as an Arabicized foreign word and is retained as a lexical entry listed under this spelling, not as a necessarily root-derived formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose intellect or judgment is weak or unsound, especially through extreme old age or disease; also one who confuses things in speech or talks excessively because of mental unsoundness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may describe weakness of intellect, judgment, or body separately, so bodily weakness does not necessarily imply faulty judgment. The lexical evidence explicitly applies this epithet to a man and not to an old woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One regarded as weak in judgment or intellect, unsound in mind, or confused in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is discussed as a counterpart of مُفْنِدٌ and may also describe extreme age or mental unsoundness; the source treats its application and nuances alongside that epithet.
